name: Howling Overswing
description: Plants both feet on a chosen bearing and brings the greatsword down in one two-handed cut along that line

name: Skirling Crossbeam
description: Turns the crossguard into the wind of an incoming blow and rolls it off the flat of the greatsword

name: Streaming Haul
description: Takes a long sliding pace on a gust of qi while keeping the heavy blade low and the grip balanced

name: Roiling Greatsweep
description: Leans the greatsword's sweep into a rising wind so the edge arrives faster and shoves the opponent back

name: Cyclonic Mulinet
description: Draws the greatsword up the body on a rising wind and drops it in a rending two-handed cut

name: Vortical Rondel
description: Wheels the greatsword in wide parrying arcs so a current of wind carries blows outward and past the wielder

name: Tornadic Wrench
description: Locks the crossguard over the opponent's weapon and presses down with wind-weighted force to bind it in place

name: Blustering Greatedge
description: Gathers wind along the greatsword and then drives the long point forward in a single piercing thrust

name: Typhonic Flange
description: Sweeps the greatsword in a wide arc that throws a crescent of compressed wind outward across open ground

name: Mistral Counterweight
description: Holds the greatsword upright on a fixed bearing while a standing storm of wind turns aside blows from every side

name: Monsoon Windmill
description: Crosses open ground in one flash of wind-driven stride and arrives with the greatsword already at the cut

name: Aeolian Heft
description: Rises on a spiral of wind and falls with the greatsword in a descent whose weight and reach follow the wind gathered

name: Skybound Greatsweep
description: Calls a storm down the raised greatsword and cuts it across open ground to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier

name: Screaming Hurricane Overswing
description: Releases one whole-body cut of wind that splits the line of the horizon to the destructive ceiling of the wielder's tier
